title: Good multiplication configurations
statement: For a Boolean-list input $x$ and a configuration with $13$ registers and a multiplication state, define the configuration to be good when it is a permitted initial configuration for the multiplication program on $x$ and every register value is at most $4(|x|+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: the configuration is in the specified pre-initialization relation for input $x$
